value.text: Jaye L. Hamby said NIFA is partnering with NSF on a national effort to ensure that every community, including rural communities, can benefit from artificial intelligence. Hamby said AI has brought agriculture to "the dawn of that reality" and described a transition from precision agriculture to decision agriculture. She said NIFA research priorities include AI and automation to address labor shortages, precision agriculture tools to improve water efficiency and reduce inputs, and decision-support technologies for producers. Hamby said investing in tools and training that meet farmers and ranchers where they are can help build a more resilient, efficient, and accessible agricultural future.
